children.value: > Fact From Story: After the leadership shake-up in November, OpenAI is going to be a changed company — perhaps not outwardly, but the trickle-down effect of Sam Altman being more fully in charge will be felt at every level.
> > Fact From Story: In a sudden late announcement, OpenAI revealed that it and Altman “have reached an agreement in principle” for him to return as the company’s CEO.

> > > Fact From Story: In a dramatic turn of events late Friday, ex-Y Combinator president Sam Altman was fired as CEO of AI startup OpenAI, the company behind viral AI hits like ChatGPT, GPT-4 and DALL-E 3, by OpenAI’s board of directors.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Returning to a position of power after being removed from it will give a person more power.

> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People who are fired from their jobs don't usually return to them unless something has changed.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Returning to a position of power after being removed from it will give a person more power.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company with a new leader will likely change.
